params.description: Data capture date (as-of date for recency/age calcs)
Fame weight - avg likes last 12 posts (log: 100=0, 1M=1)
Fame weight - max likes on any analysed post (log: 1K=0, 10M=1)
Fame weight - consistency: posts in last 30d / 20 (capped at 1)
Fame weight - longevity: max(days since first visible post / 730, (log10(posts)-1)/2.5)
Fame weight - recognizability: 40% verified badge + 60% manual rating (0-5)
Momentum weight - recent engagement = LOWER of (avg likes, last 14d) and (avg likes, last 12 posts), log: 100=0, 1M=1. Using the lower value penalises accounts that are decaying inside the window
Momentum weight - top post likes in last 14d (log: 1K=0, 10M=1)
Momentum weight - posts in last 14d / 14 (1 post/day = full)
Momentum weight - followers gained per day since first visible post (log: 100/day=0, ~31.6K/day=1). Only when first visible post <=60 days old AND >=50% of posts were analysed; else 0
Momentum weight - recency: 1 if last post <=3 days ago, linear to 0 at 30 days
Index candidate weight - Data sufficiency (0-1 x 100)

definitions: Avg/median likes & comments = the 12 most recent NON-PINNED posts. Posts whose like count is hidden by the owner (Instagram returns a placeholder of 3) are excluded from like averages and counted in 'Likes hidden'.
Posts last 7d counts every post; posts last 14d / 30d exclude pinned posts and only count posts inside the analysed sample (lower bound when the sample is shorter than the window).
Engagement rate = (avg likes + avg comments) / followers. Engagement level: Very high >=5%, High >=2%, Medium >=0.5%, Low <0.5%.
Reel view/play counts are NOT exposed to non-owners on Instagram web -> not captured (UNKNOWN). Likes are used as the reach proxy.
Distinctiveness Score = (visual + personality + lore + cross-character) manual ratings (each 0-5, blue inputs) / 20 x 100. Ratings are analyst judgements based on the observed posts/bios.
Recognizability rating (0-5, blue input) = analyst judgement: verified badge, press coverage found (non-IG, see SOURCES), and how often other characters reference the account.
Data sufficiency = (YES=1, PARTIAL=0.5, NO=0) averaged over the five flags in DATA SUFFICIENCY.
Rankings (TOP sheets) only include rows with Inclusion status = INCLUDED; ties are broken by row order.
OBSERVED = seen directly on Instagram (profile, captions, tags, counts). INFERRED = analyst interpretation of observed material. UNKNOWN = not verifiable from Instagram.
Followers/likes are point-in-time snapshots (2026-10-09, UTC+8) and change hourly for fast-growing accounts.
